title: A subgroup with vanishing Tate cohomology has index annihilating ambient Tate cohomology
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, G a finite group, A a k-linear representation of G, H a subgroup of G equipped with a finite-type structure, and q an integer. Use the common universe required by Rep.tateCohomology. If the degree-q Tate cohomology of A restricted to H is a zero object in ModuleCat k, then for every x in A.tateCohomology q, [G:H] • x = 0, where • denotes repeated addition. No normality assumption on H or finiteness assumption on A is imposed.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (q : ℤ), CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((Rep.res H.subtype A).tateCohomology q) → ∀ x : A.tateCohomology q, H.index • x = 0
